definition.def: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.
examples: The number of staff has declined from 217,000 to 114,000. [VERB + from]
Hourly output by workers declined 1.3% in the first quarter. [VERB amount]
Union membership and union power are declining fast. [VERB]

definition.def: If you decline something or decline to do something, you politely refuse to accept it or do it. [formal]
examples: The band declined to comment on the story. [VERB to-infinitive]
He offered the boys some coffee. They declined politely. [VERB]

definition.def: If there is a decline in something, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or quality.
examples: There wasn't such a big decline in enrollments after all. [+ in]
The first signs of economic decline became visible.

definition.def: If something is in decline or on the decline, it is gradually decreasing in importance, quality, or power.
examples: Thankfully the smoking of cigarettes is on the decline.
He is still one of the world's most popular golfers, but his game is in decline.

definition.def: If something goes or falls into decline, it begins to gradually decrease in importance, quality, or power.
examples: Libraries are an investment for the future and they should not be allowed to fall into decline.
